description: This Java class models a <notification> element within a configuration file, handling attributes such as subject, screen, and service with validation.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: A thread-safe, immutable class representing a notification configuration element with subject, screen, and service attributes.

methods.name: Notification
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a Notification object from an XML Element, validating attributes.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Returns the screen attribute associated with the notification.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Returns the service attribute associated with the notification.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the subject attribute associated with the notification.
